title: Hawaii under a hurricane warning as Tropical Storm Lala takes aim
script: Here is what viewers need to know right now. The key update now being reported is: Hawaii under a hurricane warning as Tropical Storm Lala takes aim. In simple words, Tropical Storm Lala could bring heavy rain, high winds and dangerous surf and rip currents to the Hawaiian Islands as a hurricane this weekend, forecasters say Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
